text: Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code; it requires careful planning around design and technology. One crucial aspect is responsive design, which ensures the app’s layout adapts smoothly to different screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for a single system, like iOS or Android, offering top performance and full access to device features. In contrast, cross-platform tools allow one codebase to run on both systems, saving time and money, though sometimes at the cost of speed. Finally, publishing on app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store is essential, where users will download the app and leave ratings that affect its success.
